text: Surpass your limits. Right here. Right now.
author: Yami Sukehiro - Black Clover

text: The only real test of intelligence is if you get what you want out of life.
author: Naval Ravikant

text: The show exist because of you, you don't exist because of the show!
author: Samay Raina (Still Alive Show)

text: My experience is what I agree to attend to.
author: William James

text: Every man has two lives, and the second starts when he realizes he has just one.
author: Confucius

text:
धृतिः क्षमा दमोऽस्तेयं शौचमिन्द्रियनिग्रहः।
धीर्विद्या सत्यमक्रोधो दशकं धर्मलक्षणम्॥
author: Manusmriti (10.63)
